text:
maria: kicking off observability commissioning for new GPU cluster in eu-central-3 (c-eu3). goal: logs, metrics, traces, base dashboards, and alert templates by end of day. checklist in thread pls.
lee: sounds good. key constraints: GPU quota is soft-limited to 48 gpus in eu-central-3, and private subnet CIDR differs from prod. we need VPC peering + route propagation confirmed.
aj: noted. I can handle metrics/traces (Prom/Tempo) and dashboards (Grafana). who will own logs ingestion (Fluentd/Vector)?
sre-alex: I'll take logs. plan: Vector to ELK-internal (es-log-01), index template redwood-logs-{env}-{date}. confirm retention policy 90d for infra logs.
maria: yes 90d infra, 365d audit. also set log-level sampling for model inference logs to 10% for DEBUG lines.
lee: infra checklist: 1) VPC peering established 2) SGs allow control plane -> nodes on 9000/9090/9091 3) private route tables updated 4) kubelet metrics accessible via node-exporter headers.
infra-bot: quota-check: GPUs available: 40/48. Need quota increase request for peak. Raised ticket #Q-4832.
aj: Prom config snippet (for later):
```
- job_name: 'k8s-nodes-eu3'
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: node
  relabel_configs:
  - action: keep
    regex: eu-central-3
    source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_node_label_region]
```
lee: Tempo collector: ensure sampler 0.5 for infra traces, 1.0 for request traces for model pipelines. store in local S3 bucket s3://redwood-eu3-traces (encrypted).
sre-alex: vector config for logs (short):
```
sources.syslog.type = "socket"
transforms.parse.type = "remap"
transforms.parse.source = "message"
sinks.elasticsearch.endpoint = "https://es-log-01.internal:9200"
```
aj: dashboards: base panels: GPU utilization (per-pod + per-node), queue latency, inference p95/p99, KV cache hit rate. will seed dashboards under folder: "EU-C3 / GPU Cluster".
maria: alerting templates draft: CPU/GPU saturation > 85% for 5m, GPU memory allocator OOMRate > 0 for 1m, node disk pressure > 80% for 10m, control-plane API errors > 5%.
lee: add alert for Prom tail-based sampling mismatch: if traces_in/requests > 10% threshold.
infra-bot: alerting template created at /infra/alerts/eu3-gpu-alerts.yaml ticket #A-9921
sre-alex: small sanity check commands for handoff:
- curl https://prom-eu3.internal/-/healthy
- kubectl get pods -n observability -l app=grafana
- curl -u user:pass https://es-log-01.internal/_cat/indices/redwood-logs-*

maria: handoff validation steps (short):
1) Verify GPU quota and node count matches cluster template (expected 10 nodes). run `gcloud compute instances list --filter="name~'c-eu3'"`
2) Validate Prom scrape targets > 95% up
3) Check Grafana folder panels render (open quick links)
4) Send test trace and ensure it appears in Tempo within 10s
5) Generate synthetic inference logs and verify ingestion and retention tag
6) Confirm alert delivery to #oncall and pagerduty test rule

aj: adding links: grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/Eu3Gpu/overview , prom: https://prom-eu3.internal , tempo: https://tempo-eu3.internal
lee: cost note: remember GPUs in eu-central-3 are ~1.3x baseline cost. suggest autoscaler profile: min 4 nodes, target 8 under baseline load, max 16 for bursts. enable scheduled scale-up for weeknights training jobs.
sre-alex: rollback plan if logging fails: switch node agent to local-file retention + s3-batch-upload, and flip Vector sink to debug-mode to push raw lines to s3.
maria: interop check: routing policies must prefer eu-central-3 for eu customers, fallback to eu-west-3 when latency > 120ms or capacity < 20%.
ops-bot: runbook entry created: /runbooks/obs/eu3-commissioning.md id=RB-3107
lee: final blockers? I still need access to es-log-01 certs and the KMS key ARN for tempo bucket.
maria: @lee and @aj have been granted temporary access. lee confirm and close when you rotate creds post-handoff.
lee: confirmed, I have certs. will rotate creds at 1832180000 and post rotation logs here.
maria: thanks all. once validation passes, I'll tag this cluster as "commissioned" and file the handoff note to infra-runbook. :tada:
sre-alex: quick note: schedule a 30m post-commissioning check at +24h. I'll own it.
aj: will push dashboards and share edit links.
infra-bot: automation run: terraform apply -target=module.obs_eu3 returned success at 1832104012
maria: marking thread as active until last check. leaving status updates below.
lee: prom targets at 1832103900 = 98% up
aj: dashboard panels rendered for all panels at 1832103987
sre-alex: test log ingestion verified at 1832104025
maria: all green, handing off to oncall for 24h monitoring. closing ticket #C-7744.
